headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.2
summary: The What's new dialog is now easier to dismiss: closing it with the system back gesture works again, and the wide Continue button is replaced by a compact close (X) button in the dialog's top-right corner. Dialogs without any buttons no longer reserve empty spacing at the bottom.

items.text: The What's new dialog can be closed with the system back navigation; the existing blur dismiss animation still runs and the release is marked as seen.
Replaced the What's new dialog's Continue button with a small close (X) button in its top-right corner.
